mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300) triggers expected monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals economic contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 700000) indicate robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in < 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
